title: Magtheridon's Lair
body: Magtheridon's Lair is the deepest vault beneath Hellfire Citadel, a great round chamber at the end of a corridor held by Hellfire warders. At its center the pit lord Magtheridon, once master of Outland, is held fast in bonds of shadow, and five Hellfire channelers stand about him, never pausing in the work that keeps him bound. Five Manticron cubes stand around the chamber's edge, and tall columns hold up the vaulted roof above them. Magtheridon rages at his jailers without end, calling them vermin and leeches, asking how long they think their sorcery can hold him, and swearing that he will crush Illidan and reclaim Outland as his own. Whoever comes this far comes to end him, and to do that they must first strike down his jailers, and so set him free.

title: Magtheridon
body: Magtheridon is a pit lord of the Burning Legion, and for a time he was the master of Outland, ruling from the Black Temple until Illidan Stormrage and his allies cast him down. Now he is a prisoner chained beneath Hellfire Citadel, held by channelers whose sorcery never rests. He has lost none of his pride. He scorns his jailers as parasites and leeches, tells them to take his blood and choke on it, offers whoever sets him free a merciful death, perhaps, and calls Illidan an arrogant fool whom he will crush before reclaiming Outland as his own.

parts.body: When his jailers were attacked, his bonds began to weaken, and at last he tore free, roaring that he was unleashed. He fought in a fury that shook the floor beneath them, and when pressed hard he called on the walls of his prison to tremble and fall, and the roof came down around the fighters. He died with a final threat: the Legion would consume them all.
sources: creature_text 17257 groups 1 (I... am... unleashed!), 4 (Let the walls of this prison tremble... and fall!), 5 (The Legion will consume you all!), 6 and 8 (bonds weaken; breaks free)
boss_magtheridon.cpp (bonds weaken on engage; release after two minutes or when the last channeler dies; Quake; at 30 percent the hall and columns collapse)

warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Magtheridon (Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne: defeated by Illidan, Kael'thas, Vashj and Akama; bound beneath Hellfire Citadel)
notes: Check: part 1 trimmed to what every fight shows: 'Who is the weak one now?' is his slay line (only when someone dies) and 'Not again!' comes only when the Manticron cubes cage him, which a fast kill can skip; both cut, Quake added. Flag 6: the blood appears only in his own taunt, and the Black Temple past is the one clause pointing to shadowmoon.json 352016, not retold. Before: This file owns Magtheridon. Opening on AREA 3836 and ACCEPT 11002/11003 (the head quests, item-started, Flags 128): who he is and what anyone in the lair hears from him; his Black Temple past in one clause (shadowmoon.json tells it). The Chronicle and Magtheridon's Lair: An Inside Look account of his arrival and forcing orcs to drink his blood is not used (later or out-of-game). Part 1 on KILL 17257 (fixed spawn, map 544 only; the Blood Furnace's 21174 is a separate entry that never fights): the fight as seen, his words, the cubes, the collapse. 'Not again' is his own line on being caged, which hints at his earlier captivity without telling it. The blood and the fel orcs stay with 383602 and the Blood Furnace file.

title: The Fall of Magtheridon
body: Magtheridon is dead, and with him falls the source of the fel orc army that Illidan Stormrage raised in Hellfire Citadel. The manufactory beneath the fortress has stopped its grim work, at least for now. Of the pit lord there remain a few trinkets and his severed head, a trophy fit for a hero of the Alliance or the Horde, and it belongs with the commanders who have fought the fel orcs since the portal opened: Force Commander Danath Trollbane at Honor Hold, or Nazgrel at Thrallmar.

parts.body: The commander took the head and spoke of what it meant. The blow fell on Illidan and on the Legion both, for a pit lord commander had been defeated, and the Legion's siege of Hellfire Citadel no longer served any purpose; its efforts would surely turn to the Black Temple. Redemption was coming for Illidan, the commander said, and soon. For the first time in as long as the commander could remember, there was silence.
sources: quests 11002 and 11003 reward text (identical: not only a blow to Illidan; a pit lord commander has been defeated; the siege of Hellfire Citadel now holds no purpose for the Burning Legion; efforts turned upon the Black Temple; Redemption comes for Illidan... and soon) and completion text (For the first time - in as long as I can remember - there is silence)
quests 11002 (to Danath, Alliance) and 11003 (to Nazgrel, Horde) descriptions, completion and reward text

Opening on ACCEPT 11002/11003 (filed under 3483 Hellfire Peninsula, check_staged warns; QuestType 2, Flags 128): the head quest's own text names the source of Illidan's army. Part 1 on DONE 11002/11003, whose texts are identical; the Black Temple prophecy is reported speech so it stays true in every era (Illidan's fall belongs to a Black Temple file). The silence line is the completion text, said by the commander. The 'siege' wording is the reward text's own. Faction 0: 11002 Alliance only, 11003 Horde only.
